findings.title: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
findings.description: S3 Bucket is not encrypted with Customer Managed Key (CMK).

findings.title: Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled
findings.description: Ensure S3 bucket has versioning enabled.
findings.remediation: Enable aws_s3_bucket_versioning to protect against accidental object overwrite or deletion.

findings.title: Ensure that an S3 bucket has a lifecycle configuration
findings.description: Ensure that an S3 bucket has a lifecycle configuration
findings.remediation: Review main.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: https://docs.prismacloud.io/en/enterprise-edition/policy-reference/aws-policies/aws-logging-policies/bc-aws-2-61

findings.title: Ensure all S3 buckets have required organizational tags (Environment, Project)
findings.description: Custom policy: S3 buckets must be tagged with Environment and Project name for cost allocation.
findings.remediation: Add mandatory tags block containing Environment (dev/stage/production) and Project tags.
findings.guideline: All S3 buckets must be tagged with Environment (dev, stage, production) and Project name for cost allocation and governance.

findings.title: Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block
findings.description: Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block
findings.remediation: Review main.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: https://docs.prismacloud.io/en/enterprise-edition/policy-reference/aws-policies/aws-networking-policies/s3-bucket-should-have-public-access-blocks-defaults-to-false-if-the-public-access-block-is-not-attached

findings.title: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
findings.description: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
findings.remediation: Review main.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: https://docs.prismacloud.io/en/enterprise-edition/policy-reference/aws-policies/aws-logging-policies/bc-aws-2-62

findings.title: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled
findings.description: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled for audit trails.
findings.remediation: Configure aws_s3_bucket_logging to store access logs in a designated security audit bucket.

findings.title: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
findings.description: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
findings.remediation: Review main.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: https://docs.prismacloud.io/en/enterprise-edition/policy-reference/aws-policies/aws-general-policies/ensure-that-s3-bucket-has-cross-region-replication-enabled
